title: Why Companies Are Firing Managers for AI
full_monologue: **Every company is replacing managers with AI.** Why? Because AI is faster, cheaper, and doesn’t take breaks. It handles tasks like scheduling, data analysis, and customer support with precision. While humans struggle with burnout, AI works 24/7 without error. Companies are seeing huge cost savings and efficiency gains. But does this mean the end of leadership? Maybe not—just a shift in roles. What do you think? Are humans still needed in the workplace?
